# Examples

This directory will contain example DEXPI files and usage scripts.

For now, you can use the reference DEXPI files from the pyDEXPI repository:

- `pyDEXPI/data/reference_pid.xml` — Reference P&ID in DEXPI XML format
- `pyDEXPI/data/reference_pid.json` — Reference P&ID in DEXPI JSON format

## Usage

```bash
# Launch DEXPI Studio and open a file via the GUI
python -m dexpi_studio.app
```

Then use **File → Open DEXPI File** to load a `.xml` or `.json` file.
